coaching.headline: Kira carried a game the map kept giving back: 12 kills, one death, a 5-1 closing fight seven items down.
coaching.team: We won this on one lane. Kira took first blood on Eden at 7.3 and never lost the carry lane; the rest of the map leaked. Iggy & Scorch and Phase died 0-2 in their jungle at 10.4 with nothing up, a bad trade. Scarlett was caught alone three times between 13.1 and 20.7, Iggy & Scorch twice, and two of those deaths came right before an outer tower fell. We took all three Fangtooths and the Genesis Core at 28, and still cashed one of four won fights. Greystone's solo death to Wukong at 29 gave them Orb Prime at 29.5. Then Kira won the fight at 30.5, 5-1 at their inner tower, seven items down on the count, 12 to 19, and the game ended. Towers finished 5-5 and they out-damaged our structures, 46,986 to 34,393. Next game: nobody walks alone after minute 12; six deaths caught alone was the whole leak.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Kira's lane, and the objectives it paid for: three Fangtooths and a Genesis Core to their one Orb Prime. The fight at 30.5, won 5-1 with Kira taking four of the kills seven items down, ended it before the Orb Prime could matter.
coaching.whatWorked: Kira on Eden: first blood at 7.3 and five kills on their carry in total, then the fight at 30.5 won 5-1 with four of the kills hers.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase did the support job in full. 14 assists on 17 team kills, 21,652 healing, the most in the game, 13 wards placed. The one death was in the bad trade at 10.4 with Iggy & Scorch, nothing up. Kira's one death came at 14.3 with Scarlett at our Fangtooth, traded for the Fangtooth in the same window; Phase has no kill or death credited there, which proves nothing about presence. Nothing to fix here.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira carried. 12 kills, 1 death, 39,153 hero damage, the most in the game, with five kills on Eden and four on Aurora. The one death, at 14.3 with Scarlett at our Fangtooth, was traded for the Fangtooth in the same window. Four kills in the closing fight at 30.5, taken seven items down on the count.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett lost a jungle that read ours all game. 0 kills, 5 deaths, 4,574 hero damage and 13,918 damage to objectives on a side out-damaged on structures 46,986 to 34,393. Three deaths caught alone between 13.1 and 20.7, to Wukong, Eden and Gideon, the last right before an outer tower fell.
perPlayer.ec0e3ed7-0f49-4ffe-8aa0-c49af17ea4fe: Greystone won a lane that read theirs all game: 4 kills, 1 death, 30,534 hero damage, 68,618 damage mitigated. The one death was the expensive kind: caught alone by Wukong at 29, and Orb Prime went to them at 29.5 with Greystone dead. No anti-heal on a build that soaked 61,952 damage against Aurora and Morigesh's healing.
perPlayer.3bacbb54-d965-4b48-9a67-f176f7d04cd5: Iggy & Scorch was the second leak. 1 kill, 4 deaths; two were solo, to Eden at 17.8 and Morigesh at 20, the first right before an outer tower fell. The fight in their jungle at 10.4, lost 0-2 with Phase, had nothing up. 24,729 hero damage and 11 wards were the good half.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Fourteen of 17 team kills, 21,652 healing and 13 wards; nothing to fix here.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Twelve kills on one death and 39,153 hero damage; the game was won in the carry lane.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Zero kills, three deaths caught alone and 13,918 objective damage in a jungle that read ours.

ec0e3ed7-0f49-4ffe-8aa0-c49af17ea4fe.text: Four kills on one death in a lane that read theirs, but that one death at 29 handed over Orb Prime.

3bacbb54-d965-4b48-9a67-f176f7d04cd5.text: Two solo deaths and a fight in their jungle at 10.4, lost 0-2 with nothing up; 11 wards is the good half.

22.5.call: Kira killed Eden and Aurora 2-0 at their outer tower with everyone alive, and nothing fell in the next 90 seconds. The call: the other three shove and walk to that tower the second the carry wins the 2v2.

24.3.call: Iggy & Scorch and Kira went 3-0 on Wukong, Eden and Aurora, and this time it turned into something: Fangtooth at 25 and an outer tower after. Keep the order: win the fight, take the objective, then the tower.

30.5.call: Seven items down on the count, 12 to 19, with Orb Prime on them, and the fight at their inner tower still went 5-1, four kills to Kira. Right call: waiting only widened the gap, and Kira was 8-1.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Marshal and Enra's Blessing from the core, with Windcaller and Vanguardian in place of Galaxy Greaves, and no lost teamfight to test the difference; nothing to teach here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Phase.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Skipped the Solaris, Ashbringer, Imperator core entirely for Vanquisher, Onixian Quiver, Tainted Rounds, Necrosis and Scattershot, carried anti-heal in Tainted Rounds into Aurora and Morigesh's healing, and went 12-1; nothing to teach here.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit into Morigesh's frontline, and gives up the item scaling a five-item Kira would have fed Demiurge.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: No magic resist against three magic damage dealers (Gideon, Morigesh, Aurora) on Manta Scythe, Malady, Earthshaker and Infernum; the solo death to Gideon at 20.7, right before an outer tower fell, is the one where it showed.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Scarlett hit for more damage dealt and less taken, the duelist fit for a jungler who wins the 1v1, and this game gave it 0 kills to work with.

ec0e3ed7-0f49-4ffe-8aa0-c49af17ea4fe.build: On the full Overlord, Rapture, Aegis Of Agawar core with Catalytic Drive for magic resist and Cursed Scroll fifth against a three-magic lineup; nothing to teach here.
ec0e3ed7-0f49-4ffe-8aa0-c49af17ea4fe.eternal: Thraex marks whoever Greystone last hit for more damage dealt and less taken, the duelist fit for an offlane that won a lane reading theirs 4-1, and gives up Krix's raw health.

3bacbb54-d965-4b48-9a67-f176f7d04cd5.build: Five items with Tainted Scepter for anti-heal in place of the core's Entropy, and no lost teamfight to test the swap; nothing to teach here.
3bacbb54-d965-4b48-9a67-f176f7d04cd5.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a mage whose kit is layered fire zones, at the cost of any durability against Gideon's burst.

threats: Heal-stacking: Aurora. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
ourKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
enemyKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

enemyKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain
